movement.name: Amphibious
movement.text: For a land or flying animal: swim speed +30 ft. For a water animal: land speed +25 ft. Can breathe air and water.

movement.name: Climbing
movement.text: Climb speed +20 ft (or 20 ft if it had none).

movement.name: Gliding
movement.text: Can drop from heights and glide down at its primary speed, falling 10 ft per turn. No fall damage. Negated if its limbs are bound.

movement.name: Jumping
movement.text: Once per turn a free jump (5 ft per Brute tier) if it attacks this turn and has made no other move; only right before or after the attack.

movement.name: Stable
movement.text: No penalties for uneven or unstable terrain.

movement.name: Water Skimming
movement.text: Land animals only: moves across water as if it were unsteady terrain.

traits.name: Adaptive Versatility
traits.text: Gives no ability. Instead +2 to two of its combat stats and +6 HP. Anything that modifies HP gained from SP also affects this HP (Hardy → +10, Extra Hardy → +14).

traits.name: Blooded
traits.text: When it becomes aware of a bleeding opponent on the battlefield: +1 Strike, plus +2 Strike more when attacking that opponent. Can stack for several bleeding opponents.

mods.label: per bleeding opponent; +2 more vs that opponent

traits.name: Boneless
traits.text: Contorts into spaces much smaller than its body. Gains the effects of Cover Expert (espionage-cover-expert) and can squeeze to one size tier smaller; a small animal can squeeze through openings a few inches wide.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.text: Active camouflage: can hide in plain sight. Bonus to its Hide roll equal to 2 × SP.

traits.name: Crushing Grab
traits.text: Can use the effect of the Crushing Grip specialty (brawl-crushing-grip) with its natural weapons.

traits.name: Constricting
traits.text: When it holds an opponent, the opponent must make a Breath Holding check as if they had no last breath. While held they suffocate and pass out when their time runs out unless they break the grab.

traits.name: Defensive Advantage
traits.text: +2 soak class on its natural armor.

traits.name: Defensive Curl
traits.text: Curls into a ball: +6 soak class and +10 Defense. No actions except leaving the stance.

traits.name: Deflection
traits.text: Deflects attacks with its body as if it had a shield.

traits.name: Disinfectant
traits.text: Secretes enzymes or eats dead flesh: allies' wounds heal at twice the normal rate (does not stack with several animals). Cancels all necrotizing effects on the player.

traits.name: Disorienting Attack
traits.text: Its attack disorients the opponent for 1 turn per strike tier.

traits.name: Echolocating
traits.text: Can hear anything it could ordinarily see, except colors and textures.

traits.name: Fearsome
traits.resist: Brute or Spirit (their choice, tiers down)
traits.text: Instead of Brute Intimidate it has Brute Terrify: the opponent takes a fear result by the animal's Brute roll, tiered down by their resist.

traits.name: Feign Death
traits.text: Gains all abilities of Feign Fatal Wounds (espionage-feign-fatal-wounds), but enters the stance reflexively and cannot act in it except to leave. Can leave reflexively when attacked and gets a free attack on the attacker (AP-costing attack modifiers still cost AP). Uses Cunning for the stance's effectiveness.

traits.name: Flesh Tearing
traits.text: When it inflicts a called-shot effect that ends after a time or after actions, that effect does not end until the opponent's bleeding has also been patched.

traits.name: Forcible Will
traits.text: Gains the benefits of Force of Self (grace-force-of-self), using Spirit instead of the Grace skill.

traits.name: Gallop
traits.text: If it spends at least 3 AP moving in a turn, it moves at twice its normal speed.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Gains 10 HP per SP instead of 6.

traits.name: Extra Hardy
traits.text: Gains 14 HP per SP instead of 10.

traits.name: Herd Instincts
traits.text: +1 Evade for each other allied animal within 25 ft that has the Herd Instincts trait or story.

traits.name: Howl
traits.text: Guttural howl: +1 per SP marque on all rolls of the next attack, or the next evade and defense attempt, of an ally within 25 ft.

traits.name: Hypnotic
traits.text: Hypnotic gaze: benefits from Connection (grace-connection), using Spirit instead of Grace for the bonus.

traits.name: Ink
traits.resist: As a called shot to the eyes (usually Dexterity)
traits.text: Called shot to the eyes with ink using only its Accuracy, for 2 AP. No damage; if not resisted the target is blinded and acts as if fighting in darkness until they spend 2 AP to clean it out. Uses per breather = SP marque; anything that changes its venom dose count changes this too.

traits.name: Intimidating
traits.text: Its Brute intimidations are one tier more effective. Above T4: +1 to the AP that cannot be used to attack it. With Fearsome: fear effect +1 tier (max T4).

traits.name: Loud
traits.text: Loud aggressive noises: opponents must roll concentration (Spirit) against the animal's Cunning to notice silent movement or hear allies' vocal cues.

traits.name: Mobile
traits.text: Gains an additional movement trait. Can be taken several times; no movement trait more than once.

traits.name: Offensive Advantage
traits.text: Its natural attacks gain +2 damage class.

traits.name: Pack Instincts
traits.text: +1 Strike for each other allied animal within 25 ft that has the Pack Instincts trait or story.

traits.name: Phase Step
traits.text: Benefits of Phase Step (agility-phase-step), using Dexterity instead of Agility.

traits.name: Piercing Attacks
traits.text: All its attacks make the opponent bleed 2 additional HP per turn per strike tier.

traits.name: Predatory Instinct
traits.text: Against one opponent type (e.g. Humanoids, Automatons, Vehicles, Land Animals, Abominations, Birds, Fishes, Living Liquids): +1 per SP marque on all combat rolls and +2 to all damage classes. Repeatable once per type; an opponent fitting several types is only affected once.

traits.name: Revitalizing
traits.text: Acts as a natural bio-invigorator (core Bio-Flux) that uses its Spirit attribute to determine healing.

traits.name: Sharp Senses
traits.text: Camouflaged opponents, or opponents hidden behind cover, get no hide bonus against it from those effects.

traits.name: Social
traits.text: Part of a social unit (domesticated, hivemind, pride, pack…), capable of rudimentary communication; tamed as if it had half its SP (rounded up).

traits.name: Stink
traits.text: Sprays an enemy within 10 ft: rolls to hit, then the target resists (Brute or Spirit) against its Accuracy; on a failure the target is nauseated. Uses = SP marque (per breather); anything that changes its venom dose count changes this too.

traits.name: Tough Body
traits.text: +2 Wounds per SP.

traits.name: Trample
traits.text: +2 damage class with any melee or unarmed weapon against a prone opponent; +2 soak class against melee attacks of a prone opponent. Mostly unimpeded by prone opponents (narrator).

traits.name: Verbally Reactive
traits.text: Understands basic language (cannot talk back); benefits from all specialties that involve talking.

traits.name: Versatile Essence
traits.text: Knows three 1-slot essence augments (core essence list) and switches between them for 1 AP; only one active at a time; uses no essence slot. Augment marque = SP marque.

traits.name: Vocal
traits.text: Imitates normal speech convincingly without understanding it. Telling whether it speaks real words: Cunning vs the animal's Cunning.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: Called shots to the chest can knock the opponent back and prone, landing in the opponent's square. While there, the opponent counts as grabbed and cannot stand up until they break the grab or the animal disengages.

traits.name: Slam
traits.text: Called shots to the chest knock the opponent back an additional 5 ft and prone.

traits.name: Winding Attack
traits.text: Modifies a called shot to the chest: opponents who are drowning/suffocating, or start to within a turn of a successful winding attack, lose half (rounded up) of the time they could hold their breath and cannot take a last breath. The opponent counts as suffocating for the rest of their turn, so repeated Winding Attacks can suffocate them.

traits.name: Prehensile Limbs
traits.text: Grasping limbs: can use basic melee weapons, polearms and throwing weapons, and basic alchemical potions (medicine, poison, acid; no beta alchemy). Gains a 1 AP unarmed attack with the limbs at damage class 2, so it can grab for 1 AP.

traits.name: Hurl
traits.resist: Brute or Dexterity (their choice, tiers down)
traits.text: With an opponent grabbed: throw them 5 ft per Brute tier, dealing 5 damage per tier. A throw of more than 10 ft knocks the victim prone; throwing into a solid object/wall deals +3 damage per Brute tier.

traits.name: Tool User
traits.text: Understands and uses complex tools: basic ranged weapons (firearms, bows, crossbows). Can use the Sciences ability Understand to figure out any crafted item; cannot hack beta items.

traits.name: Extra Venoms
traits.text: +1 venom dose per SP marque.

traits.name: Nematocysts
traits.text: When it grabs an opponent it may spend 1 AP to apply its poison.

traits.name: Poisonous Spit
traits.text: Delivers its poison to an opponent up to 10 ft away; the opponent may evade the spit.

traits.name: Acidic
traits.resist: As a sundering resist, or Dexterity (tiers down)
traits.text: Dissolves most untreated organic material. An acid spit/nematocyst grab may target an opponent or an item at the normal cost. Against a dissolvable item = normal sundering attempt with Accuracy +1 tier. Against a person in dissolvable armor: Dexterity vs the animal's Accuracy; soak class −1 per Accuracy tier, tiered down by the Dexterity roll.

traits.name: Blinding
traits.text: Blinded status for a number of turns by SP marque.

traits.name: Burn Inducing
traits.text: Burnt status at a tier by SP marque.

traits.name: Deafening
traits.text: Deafened status for a number of turns by SP marque.

traits.name: Local Swelling
traits.text: When delivering the poison it picks a called-shot location; the target gets that location's Wound effect until their next breather or an antitoxin. Once per opponent at a time (a new use replaces the old one). If delivered by a called shot, that location is used; eyes/ears/neck → head wound effect, groin → chest wound effect.

traits.name: Maddening
traits.text: Rage: the victim spends AP (by SP marque) attacking wildly, first whoever recently attacked them, then anyone nearby.

traits.name: Mentally Clouding
traits.text: Penalty to Cunning and Sciences rolls for a number of turns by SP marque.

traits.name: Muscle Relaxing
traits.text: The victim falls prone involuntarily and cannot get up for a time by SP marque.
traits.note: PDF p.21 prints only Mq I '1 turn' and Mq III '2 turns'; II/IV assumed equal to the row above

traits.name: Nauseating
traits.text: Nausea status, but it lasts until the victim has spent AP by SP marque.

traits.name: Necrosis
traits.text: Any wound effect the victim gets while poisoned is permanent until a doctor treats it or it is otherwise healed.

traits.name: Neurotoxin
traits.text: Stunned for an amount of AP by SP marque.

traits.name: Painful
traits.text: Unsoakable damage by SP marque.

traits.name: Psychoactive
traits.text: Hallucinations: the target must make a Cunning roll for every action; on a failure it spends 1 AP moving aimlessly (narrator). Difficulty and duration by SP marque.
marques: Tier 2 Cunning results required to move for 1 turn
Tier 2 Cunning results required to make any actions for 2 turns
Tier 3 Cunning results required to make any actions for 3 turns
Tier 3 Cunning results required to make any actions for 4 turns

traits.name: Rusting
traits.text: Rapid rusting agent (common near Mt. Sibrius, Siyesh): on contact, metal armor (including natural metal armor and metal suits) loses 2 soak class and all movement encumbrances worsen by −10 ft.

traits.name: Weakening
traits.text: Penalty to Brute and Dexterity rolls for a number of turns by SP marque.

traits.name: Withering
traits.text: Penalty to Spirit rolls for a number of turns by SP marque.

traits.name: Poisonous Bite
traits.text: Attack with its natural bite and apply its venom; the attack must deal damage for the venom to take effect.

stories.name: Additional AP 1
stories.text: The animal has 4 AP per turn.

stories.name: Additional AP 2
stories.text: The animal has 5 AP per turn.

stories.name: Armorable
stories.text: Can wear any ordinary armor a player could wear. Armor does not add to natural soak: use whichever soak class is higher. May wear augmented armor but cannot use its AP-cost abilities.

stories.name: Mountable
stories.text: Usable as a mount: medium → gnome-sized riders only; large → up to elf-sized riders.

stories.name: Socialized
stories.text: Understands humanoid social cues; can use basic social-tells rolls to read others (may miss the context).

stories.name: Sequenced Orders
stories.text: Takes sequences of orders (e.g. scout an area, return if it finds something, show the tamer where it is). If disrupted it can be ordered to fight or return.

stories.name: Wild Lab Assistant
stories.text: While the animal is present and not being trained, its owner gets +3 DIY. Does not stack for several animals; no new training in downtimes where this is used.

stories.name: Herd Instincts
stories.text: Story form of the trait (book mentions 'trait or story'; given by a herd).

stories.name: Pack Instincts
stories.text: Story form of the trait (given by a pack).

printed.name: Dog
printed.pack: Solitary (easy, level 1 party) or small pack (par, level 1)
printed.note: HP 9 printed although 4 SP (expected 33) – check PDF p.24

printed.name: Wolf
printed.pack: Solitary (par L1), small pack 2-6 (par L3), large pack 7-12 (par L5)

printed.name: Small Feline
printed.examples: Bobcat, Caracal, Cat, Jaguarundi, Lynx, Manul, Ocelot, Onza, Pampas Cat
printed.pack: Solitary or pair (par L1), avoids combat

printed.name: Cougars & Leopards
printed.domestication: Ridden by gnomes (cougars in Old Siddeodru, leopards in Valdru); cougars kept as pets in Izeda

printed.name: Lions, Tigers, & Jaguars
printed.trait_notes: Crushing Grab (Bite); Pack Instincts lion only; Sharp Senses tigers & jaguars only
printed.pack: Solitary (par L3-4) or pack of 4 (par L6)
printed.note: HP 60 = 8 SP but only 7 traits apply per variant

printed.name: Goats & Sheep
printed.domestication: Herded in most temperate or cool flatlands

printed.name: Rams
printed.domestication: Some rugged gnomes scout mountains riding a ram

printed.name: Deer, Gazelles, & Zebras
printed.pack: Deer: small groups; gazelles & zebras: large herds; avoid combat

printed.name: Elk & Moose
printed.pack: Solitary (par L1) or small herd of 3-5 (par L3)
printed.domestication: Unconfirmed legends of Tordryoni moose cavalry

printed.name: Horse
printed.domestication: Often domesticated in Rilausia and the islands; a mountable/armorable horse gives low-level characters a big advantage on even terrain

printed.name: Chimpanzee
printed.pack: Individual or pair (par L2-3) or group of 3-6 (par L5)
printed.note: May use any non-crafted melee or thrown weapon as if a gnome. Soak 4/8/12/16 printed without Defensive Advantage – check PDF p.28

printed.name: Gorilla
printed.pack: Individual (par L5) or group of 3-6 (par L9)

list: Nauseating: 4 AP to purge (Brute marques down)

printed.name: Mambas
printed.pack: Solitary (par L4) or ambush of 3-5 (par L6-8)

list: Neurotoxin: 3 AP (Brute marques down; trait says Spirit)

printed.name: Demi-Gnome "Goblins"
printed.pack: Individual (par L8) or squad of 3-5 (par L11-12); may attack pre-emptively but leave if offered tribute
printed.domestication: Rarely tamed as guards/assistants of powerful scientists (Paldorus, Zelhost, Suulrai); frowned upon in Rilausia

list: Acidic: -1 soak class per Acc tier or +1 tier sundering (resist as sunder)
Rusting: -2 soak class and -10 ft move for metal-clad opponents (Dexterity negates)

printed.note: Uses any melee/ranged/thrown weapon as if a gnome, usually up to Mq2 augmentation

printed.name: Demi-Ayodin "Carbuncles"
printed.pack: Hunting squad of 4-6 (par L10) or squad of 3-5 (par L11-12); strike pre-emptively from forest or underwater cover
printed.domestication: Exceedingly rare; frowned upon in Rilausia

attacks.name: Stolen exotic game hunting spear (Mq3 Prototype Bone-Shattering, Static, Streamlined; medium polearm)
attacks.note: Static Attack: 1 reflexive AP after a hit: target -3 Evade until wielder's next turn; usable more than once per attack

list: Necrosis: wounds permanent until tended by a doctor (Brute negates)

printed.name: Demi-Elf "Ogres"
printed.pack: Solitary (par L10) or pair (par L12); uninterested in combat but very territorial
printed.domestication: Rumoured tamed in Paldorus; frowned upon in Rilausia

attacks.name: Stolen Giant Spear (Mq1 Damaging, Torso-Seeking; super-heavy polearm)
attacks.note: Always attacks the torso; elsewhere Acc only +2
